scope: Theorem 10.1 (Stable primitive generators) of the manuscript “Filtered chromatic splitting at generic primes” (preprints/Filtered-chromatic-splitting-at-generic-primes-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 318 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 f2aeefc98af1afcd), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 80. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let 1 ≤ N ≤ p − 2. There are classes ca,i ∈ π1−2iC∗ cts(Ga; S), 1 ≤ i ≤ a ≤ N, with leading integral classes αa,i ∈ H2i−1 cts (Ga, Zp), having the following properties. 1. The classes αa,i induce isomorphisms of graded algebras ^ Zp (αa,1, . . . , αa,a) ∼ − − → H∗ cts(Ga, Zp), ^ Fp (αa,1, . . . , αa,a) ∼ − − → H∗ cts(Ga, Fp). Their rationalizations are nonzero multiples of the standard primitive classes. For i = 1 the class is the divided determinant logarithm. 2. For the upper-left block inclusion Gb −→ Ga, with b ≤ a, one has res αa,i = αb,i (i ≤ b), res αa,i = 0 (b < i ≤ a). The sphere representatives can be chosen so that res ca,i = cb,i for i ≤ b. 3. Apply Proposition 9.5 at rank N. The classes cN,i have transported representatives ui ∈ π1−2iC∗ cts(PN ; S). Their leading mod-p classes, denoted ξi, are the transported classes αN,i. On the extension space with a marked connected quotient and an m-dimensional Tate kernel, their constant cohomology action is the upper-left block restriction of αN,i, hence is given by αm,i for i ≤ m and vanishes for i > m.
